Pearls are typically found in mollusks, specifically bivalve mollusks such as oysters and mussels.

To enrich the artistic concept of the urban life exhibition, the hip-hop playlist can be curated to mirror the rhythm of the city. The relentless pace of urban living can be reflected in fast-paced, high-energy beats that mimic the sound of traffic and subway trains. Lyrical flow can be selected to tell stories of grit and resilience, echoing the struggles and triumphs of city dwellers. The characteristic bass lines can provide a grounding pulse, much like the heartbeat of the metropolis, while samples of city noises—sirens, footsteps, and street chatter—can be woven into the tracks to create an immersive auditory landscape that complements the visual art pieces.
